name: immortal
description: The player never loses energy and never dies. Enemies stay visible and solid.
evidence: the damage routine has two entries: $2B88 sets up and falls through, and $2B8F is a separate lifted function entry, so patching only $2B88 leaves callers entering lower down unaffected
$2B8F decrements the energy count at $3B, and $2B93 loads 1 into the death flag at $62 when that decrement reaches zero
replacing the decrement with LDA #$01 leaves the Z flag clear so the guarding BNE always skips the death store, and $2630 begins TYA/PHA/LDA $3B so clobbering A is safe
loading 0 rather than 1 before the death store makes it harmless even if some path reaches it, which covers the case where a caller enters below the decrement
qualifications: $2732 also writes the death flag, inside the control poller and reached by a key nothing has ever pressed, so it is left alone
damage still plays its sound and redraws the bar, so contact stays visible and audible; only the cost is removed
enemies remain drawn and solid: obstruction by an enemy is not what this changes
the f2 and f3 INKEY numbers are derived rather than proved by play
